description: Submit a code from the in-game Admin Panel for one account. Rewards land on the account; lobby effects only play in game.

no-accounts.title: No linked accounts
no-accounts.description: Add an account to submit codes.

form.title: Admin Panel code
form.description: One code for one account. Nothing is sent until you press Submit.
form.account-hint: The code is submitted for this account only.
form.length: {{length}} of {{max}} characters. Sent exactly as typed.

problems.line-break: One code at a time: remove the line break.
problems.characters: Tabs and other control characters are not allowed.
problems.too-long: That is {{length}} characters; the limit is {{max}}.
problems.multi-line-paste: That paste has more than one line. Paste one code at a time.

result.can-repeat: Epic says this code can be used again on this account.
result.check-first: Check the account in game before submitting this code again.

granted.label: Granted
granted.title: Rewards granted
granted.body: Epic confirmed the code and granted its rewards.

no-reward.label: No reward
no-reward.title: No reward granted
no-reward.body: Epic accepted the code but granted nothing. This account may already have its rewards.

unconfirmed.label: Unconfirmed
unconfirmed.title: Not confirmed
unconfirmed.body: Epic answered without confirming a reward.

invalid-code.label: Invalid
invalid-code.title: Code not recognised
invalid-code.body: Check the code and try again.

already-used.label: Already used
already-used.title: Already used
already-used.body: This account has already used this code.

cooldown.label: Cooldown
cooldown.title: On cooldown
cooldown.body: Epic is limiting attempts. Wait a moment, then try again.

unavailable.label: Unavailable
unavailable.title: Not available
unavailable.body: Fortnite is not accepting this command right now.

auth-failed.label: Sign-in failed
auth-failed.title: Could not sign in
auth-failed.body: Epic refused this account's saved sign-in. Sign in again, then retry.

account-missing.label: No account
account-missing.title: Account not linked
account-missing.body: That account is no longer linked to Penny. Pick another.

not-sent.label: Not sent
not-sent.title: Could not reach Epic
not-sent.body: Nothing was sent. Check your connection and try again.

uncertain.label: Unknown
uncertain.title: Result unknown
uncertain.body: No answer came back from Epic, so the code may or may not have gone through.

busy.label: Busy
busy.title: Still submitting
busy.body: Another code is still being submitted. Wait for it to finish.

invalid-input.label: Not sent
invalid-input.title: Not sent
invalid-input.body: The code or account was not valid, so nothing was sent.

codes.title: Lobby Hack codes
codes.description: {{count}} codes from community guides, checked {{date}}. Pick a reward code to put it in the form.
